mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_job (owner_id, report_type, format, filters_json, status, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{reportType}, #{format}, #{filtersJson}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{owner}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_job WHERE owner_id = #{owner}
SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE owner_id = #{owner} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE report_job SET status = 'RUNNING', run_token = #{token}, started_at = #{now}, attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE report_job SET status = 'COMPLETED', finished_at = #{now}, expires_at = #{expiry}, row_count = #{rows} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND run_token = #{token}
UPDATE report_job SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = #{now}, error_message = #{message} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND run_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at <= #{cutoff} ORDER BY started_at, id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE report_job SET status = IF(attempts < 2, 'PENDING', 'FAILED'), finished_at = IF(attempts < 2, NULL, #{now}), error_message = IF(attempts < 2, NULL, '任务中断，请重新申请导出'), started_at = NULL, run_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND run_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM report_job WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE report_job SET status = 'EXPIRED', run_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND run_token = #{token} AND expires_at <= #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM report_job WHERE run_token = #{token} AND status IN ('RUNNING','COMPLETED'))
